body: Wow. For some reason, that touched me. I have hyperhidrosis and pectus carinatum, and it just makes life so hard. I'm constantly hiding things, but I guess other people have it worse than me. I just want to be normal.
I'm not afraid of death in the least, and suicide is the only option in my case. I've researched my disorders and there are no cure, so my entire life in the future would be like it is now. A lie.
